name: DevEraXTech
description: DevEraXTech is a web design and development studio based in Cairo, Egypt, building secure, scalable, pixel-perfect websites, online stores, web and mobile apps, desktop software and AI integrations, with ongoing care plans, for clients in Canada, the United States, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt.

contact.hours: Every day, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Cairo time)

services.name: Business / Corporate Websites
services.summary: Professional websites for companies, startups, agencies, shops, clinics, factories and schools, with home, about, services, team, portfolio and contact pages.

services.name: E-Commerce Websites
services.summary: Online stores with product pages, a shopping cart, checkout, payment integrations and an admin dashboard.

services.name: Shopify Stores
services.summary: Bespoke Shopify stores for premium brands, with designed product pages, a seamless cart, trusted payments and full store control.

services.name: WordPress Websites
services.summary: Custom WordPress websites with responsive, high-performance layouts, secure plugins and easy content management.

services.name: Portfolio Websites
services.summary: High-visual showcase websites for designers, photographers, developers and agencies.

services.name: Landing Pages
services.summary: High-conversion single pages for marketing campaigns, app launches, product launches and service promotions.

services.name: Custom Web Applications
services.summary: Custom web applications built around how your business runs, from CRMs and booking systems to client portals and dashboards.

services.name: Mobile Apps
services.summary: iOS and Android apps built with React Native from one shared codebase, designed to feel native on every device.
includes: App Store & Google Play release support

services.name: Desktop Software
services.summary: Windows apps like Klozcrew: fast, dependable desktop software for teams that work on their own machines.

services.name: AI Integrations
services.summary: AI chatbots, WhatsApp assistants, automated lead handling and document processing, connected to the tools you already use.

services.name: Payment & Business Integrations
services.summary: Payment and business integrations with Paymob, Fawry, Stripe, WhatsApp Business, CRMs and accounting tools.

services.name: Maintenance & Care Plans
services.summary: Ongoing care for live websites and apps: updates, security patches, backups, uptime monitoring, performance checks and priority support.

services.name: SEO & Performance Optimization
services.summary: Technical SEO, structured data and Core Web Vitals improvements that help your website load faster and get found.

services.name: Redesigns & Migrations
services.summary: Modern redesigns and careful platform migrations that refresh your website without losing content, rankings or data.
includes: Moves to Shopify, WordPress or a custom build

services.name: UI/UX Design
services.summary: Figma designs for teams with their own developers: user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens and developer-ready handoff.

portfolio.name: Nilora Estates: Luxury Real Estate Platform, Cairo
portfolio.summary: A full MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) platform for Nilora Estates, a private residential agency selling villas, penthouses and coastal homes across Cairo and the Egyptian coast. It has a cinematic public site plus three role-based dashboards: buyers save homes and book private viewings, agents manage their listings and leads, and admins control properties, advisors, users and content.

portfolio.name: Karim Ahmed: Full-Stack Developer Portfolio Website
portfolio.summary: A personal portfolio website for Karim Ahmed, a full-stack MERN developer and the founder of DevEraXTech, based in Cairo. Its cinematic, darkroom and film-roll design presents featured projects such as a university events and facilities management platform, along with skills, work experience, private one-on-one teaching sessions and a contact form. It is built to be secure, accessible and fast, with no third-party trackers.
